entries.category_description: Restaurant and catering services, it being possible to exclude the supply of (alcoholic and/or non-alcoholic) beverages
Restaurant and catering services, it being possible to exclude the supply of (alcoholic and/or non-alcoholic) beverages
entries.comment:
Restaurant and catering services except serving beverages other than drinking water and selected drinks; serving drinking water and selected drinks. 
Selected drinks (non-alcoholic beverage) are milk and liquid milk products, plant-based milk alternatives (CN 2202 99 11 and 2202 99 15), even if they contain added sugar or other sweetening matter, additive or other food, provided they retain the essential character of such beverages.

entries.category_description: Restaurant and catering services, it being possible to exclude the supply of (alcoholic and/or non-alcoholic) beverages
entries.comment: The reduced rate (RR) applies to restaurant and catering services, excluding night clubs. Moreover, the RR applies to the delivery or take-away of non-alcoholic beverages (nAB) from companies that are dealing with restaurant and catering services. The standard rate still applies to alcoholic beverages IN ANY CASE (i.e. serving, delivery or take away) and ONLY in the serving of nAB

entries.comment:
Administration of food and beverages, carried out also through vending machines; provision of services dependent on procurement contracts relating to the supply or administration of food and beverages.
Limited to food and beverage administration and catering services.

entries.category_description: Restaurant and catering services, it being possible to exclude the supply of (alcoholic and/or non-alcoholic) beverages
entries.comment: Tabel I prov. b.12: serving out foodstuffs for human consumption, for use on site within the context of a hotel, café, restaurant, guesthouse and related businesses. The supply of freshly prepared food or edible products for immediate consumption in snack bars, snack vans, cinema foyers, sports club canteens and such is considered a supply of goods, unless the services accompanying the delivery of the foodstuffs predominate.
